text:
jen: Quick check — PR #20499 is green on linux but mac-e2e flaked twice. We need this to land before the Tue deploy freeze. Anyone able to give a short rebase window or rerun?
pranay: @jen what's the failure? flaky or real test break?
sasha: looks like the mac-run timed out on a single flaky test `metrics/check_ping`. Timeout only in the 10m job.
jen: flaky. only failed on the mac lane. linux + windows passed.
pranay: OK. I can try a targeted rerun for the mac matrix in ~15m. Need someone to +1 the PR after rebase if it passes.
jen: thanks — i left one tiny comment re: log level, nothing blocking.
release-manager: heads-up: we have two pre-freeze canary slots left (mon 18:00 UTC and mon 21:00 UTC). If this lands, prefer the 18:00 one.
sasha: can we avoid a full rebase? if the change is small, rerun mac only.
jen: yes small. prefer rerun.
ci-bot: @pranay triggered rerun for PR #20499 (mac-e2e). Job: mac-e2e-2024-06-20-01 queued.
alex: pinging eng-oncall to bump priority if mac queue is slow. @ci-bot is there a way to target just that test?
ci-bot: You can re-run a specific job: `gh actions run rerun --job mac-e2e --pr 20499` — or use /retest in PR thread.
pranay: running `gh actions run rerun --job mac-e2e --pr 20499` now.
pranay: status: mac-e2e started. ETA ~8m.
jen: i'll keep eyes on flakes dashboard and add the quick changelog entry if it passes.
release-manager: FYI if mac queue doesn't start within 10m, we should consider scheduling into 21:00 slot and freeze-team will need a heads-up.
sasha: also we have a rebase window at 17:30-18:15 UTC for patches. Could rebase+force-land there if rerun fails.
pranay: mac job passed ✅ — pushing for review approval.
alex: i'm +1 on the tiny log-level tweak.
jen: thanks @alex — added approval in GH.
release-manager: nice. I've reserved the 18:00 UTC canary slot for this PR; will roll it if nothing else blocks. :thumbsup:
pranay: merging in 2m. running `gh pr merge 20499 --merge`
ci-bot: Merge started for PR #20499. Post-merge CI: runtime smoke and canary prep triggered.
jen: leaving a note: if we see any perf regressions in canary, we rollback and revert the PR.
sasha: noted. great choreography everyone.
alex: thanks all. :party_parrot:
release-manager: closing the loop — canary scheduled and I'll post status after the first hour.
